description.value:
Whenever you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to perform a blitz attack instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, your choice.

Demoralizing Attack. The target attempts a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

Diverting Attack. Roll two Sneak Attack dice. The next time before the start of your next turn that the target would deal damage, reduce that damage by the amount rolled.

Warmonger's Attack. If the target attacks you or an ally within 5 feet of you before the start of your next turn, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.
